steps: Drain the soaked urad dal and rajma, add about 200 ml fresh water a person, and pressure cook on medium for about 10 whistles.
Let the pressure drop. A bean should mash easily; if not, cook 3 to 4 more whistles. Then lightly mash some of the dal.
Heat the ghee with the bay leaf on medium and fry the onion for about 7 minutes, until golden.
Add the ginger and garlic and stir for about a minute, until they smell good.
Add the tomato, chilli powder, garam masala and salt and cook 4 to 5 minutes, until thick and the fat shows at the edges.
Add the dal with its water and simmer on low for 60 to 90 minutes, stirring often and adding hot water when it gets too thick.
Stir in the crushed kasuri methi and the cream and cook 6 to 8 minutes more, until thick and creamy.
Turn off the heat and mix in the butter.
note: Both sources agree closely, at about 52 g of dry dal and beans a person. Cumin, green chilli, oil and coriander leaves are gone because neither source uses them.
